decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
Dilated right atrium and right ventricle
response.rationale: The defect with left-to-right shunt and oxygen step-up at the atrial level is diagnostic of atrial septal defect; RBBB is a secondary ECG finding, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: RBBB is an ECG pattern that can result from ASD volume overload, not the underlying most likely diagnosis.
